scenes.subtitle: One shape, every chord.
lines: This lesson teaches one shape that makes every chord.

scenes.heading: One shape, every chord
points: Slide the shape to change chords
lines: Place finger 1 on string 6 at any fret, then finger 3 two frets higher on string 5, and finger 4 on string 4 at the same fret as finger 3.
Slide the whole shape up or down the neck to play different chords — the note under finger 1 names the chord.
The same pattern works starting on string 5, so you can play power chords anywhere on the neck with confidence.
Here's how it sounds: strummed, then string by string.
scenes.tip: The movable shape with its root under finger 1 on string 6. Let finger 1 lightly mute the strings you don't play.

lines: Let's play the C5 power chord — a simple, strong shape with three strings and no major or minor variation.
Here's how it sounds: strummed, then string by string.
scenes.tip: The G5 shape one string higher; the root is under finger 1 on string 5. Don't hit string 6.

lines: Let's play the F power chord.
It's a simple shape that moves up and down the neck.
Here's how it sounds: strummed, then string by string.
scenes.tip: The movable shape at fret 1. Strum only strings 6, 5 and 4.

lines: Let's practice changing between G, C and F power chords.
Move your fingers smoothly and keep the rhythm steady.

points: Slide the shape to change chords
lines: Slide the shape to G5, C5 or F5.
Now play along while the app listens — it's your turn to shine.
